content: tɔnun bii, resɛm dɑ̃ɑ yɑ dɑ̃ɑ ye yɑ tie bɛɛrɛ kere? Yen dɑ̃ɑ kɑ̃ɑsɑ yɑ dɑ̃ɑ kɑ̃ɑsi yi yi tie kere?
Bɑ koo kpĩ bu ye dendi bu kɑ sɔmburu ɡɑru ko? Bɑ koo kpĩ bu kɑ ye ɡɑbɑtiɑ ko?
Geemɑ yɑ wɑ̃ɑwɑ bu kɑ ye dɔ̃ɔ sɔ̃re ɑdɑmɑ yen nɔsu yiru kpuro kɑ yen suunu sɔɔ yɑ̀ n dɔ̃ɔ mwɑɑrɑ sɔmbu terɑ̀ yɑ koo mɑɑ kpĩ yu ko.
Sɑnɑm mɛ yɑ ǹ dɔ̃ɔ mwɑɑre bɑ ǹ kɑ ye ɡɑ̃ɑnu kue. Kɑɑ sere ɡere ye yɑ den dɔ̃ɔ mwɑɑrɑ, yɑ ǹ mɑɑ ɡɑru koorɔ?
Wee ye nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ ɡerumɔ. Nɡe mɛ dɑ̃nu sɔɔ resɛm dɑ̃ɑ bɑ rɑ dɔ̃ɔ doke, nɡe mɛyɑ kon mɑɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɡibu sɛɛyɑsiɑ.
Kon bu wɔrimɑ. Bɑ tɑmɑɑ bɑ yɑrɑ dɔ̃ɔn di. Adɑmɑ dɔ̃ɔ wi, u koo nɑ u bu di, kpɑ bu ɡiɑ mɑ nɛnɑ nɑ sɑ̃ɑ Yinni Gusunɔ.
Kon de ben tem mɛ, mu ko bɑnsu, domi bɑ mɑn mɛm nɔɔbu sɑriru koosi. Nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔwɑ nɑ yeni ɡeruɑ.
